driversFound: Flavour (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances): "flavour" (cosmetic_additive)research/02 marker class 2 (flavourings)

Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein: "hydrolysed vegetable protein" (derived_substance)PROVISIONAL: FAO 2019 (Monteiro et al.), ca5644en.pdf, p. 9 (section 2, ingredients characteristic of ultra-processed foods) "include varieties of sugars (fructose, high-fructose corn syrup, ‘fruit juice concentrates’, invert sugar, maltodextrin, dextrose, lactose), modified oils (hydrogenated or interesterified oils) and sources of protein (hydrolysed proteins, soya protein isolate, gluten, casein, whey protein, and ‘mechanically separated meat’)"; classification basis FAO 2019, ca5644en.pdf, p. 10 (section 3, identifying ultra-processed foods) "The presence in the list of ingredients of one or more of these food substances identifies a product as ultra-processed."; instance of the named class 'hydrolysed proteins' (class-level coverage); exact term not named by the clause
